$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM (sub2api single-enclave architecture). Fetched at runtime by the /proof page (see frontend/src/utils/attestation/reference.ts). Every change to this file is public git history — that is part of the trust story. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 via the attestor's event log on 2026-08-03 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report a199f53d. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v14 indexes built from sourceCommit by publish-tee-images (run 30778961874); the keyless signatures were verified against certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/proof-solo, and the Fulcio certificates embed githubWorkflowSha = the sourceCommit below, so the digest-to-source binding is cryptographic rather than self-reported. This release is a security update: it merges upstream sub2api v0.1.170, which fixes GHSA-vrxq-qm4h-6hgg (High, CVSS 3.1 8.5) — a path traversal in the three POST /responses/*subpath wildcard routes that let any holder of a valid platform API key relay POST requests to arbitrary upstream paths under the operator's pooled account credentials. The code measured by the previous reference (proof-v13, composeHash 4092bc20, built from upstream baseline v0.1.165-51-g95590b553) was in the affected range >= v0.1.135, <= v0.1.168 and did contain the vulnerable routes; that history stays in this file's git log deliberately. The merge deliberately keeps this fork's own HomeView.vue instead of adopting upstream's new custom-home-content branch, which renders operator-supplied HTML via v-html and would add an XSS surface to the landing page, and its iframe branch would require widening the Content-Security-Policy frame-src that is itself measured into this image. As with proof-v12 and proof-v13, composeHash could NOT be predicted ahead of the deploy, so it was read back afterwards; between the CVM update and this commit, /proof reported a mismatch against this file as a failed enclave. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged, so the enclave's E2EE public key, derived from the app key, is also unchanged.
